verdict.rationale: Aleph's Scan AI analyst runs flux and variance analysis and produces commentary on what changed and why it matters. It suggests explanatory dimensions such as vendor, applies user-set materiality thresholds, and says when it finds nothing rather than inventing an explanation. This goes beyond flagging variances. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of explanation quality, and explicit documentation that budget-to-actual (not only flux/period-over-period) variances get the same driver commentary.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the platform explains a budget-to-actual or period-over-period variance rather than only flagging it
